statistics.test: two-sided one-sample t-test on donor-specific log2 treated-minus-vehicle differences
statistics.intervals: pointwise 95% Student t; selected features; not simultaneous or selection-adjusted
statistics.heatmap: top 16 proteins ranked by q then ID; columns in donor ID order; paired differences, no row scaling or clustering
statistics.ecdf: donor-level median over all measured proteins; descriptive only; no inference across proteins

metadata.purpose: Simulated study; figure-design demonstration, not experimental evidence

notes: PDF is the preferred editable main-figure output.
SVG is an editable working copy; PNG is a preview only.
Statistical metadata are supplied by the analyst and are not independently validated.
